 NBA's Next Generation of Superstars - Who Will Dominate the League? 
 - October 21, 2026 
 Eurobasket   
 POSTED BY: Eurobasket 
 Follow us on 
The NBA is the world's most popular basketball league and home to the best players. People from all over the world follow their favorite teams' games because they want to watch them in action. Names like LeBron James have shaped the modern sport, but the truth is that the NBA is home to many upcoming players who will become global stars. 
 As the 2026-27 NBA season begins, we can already see many young players stepping up their game. In fact, they are no longer simply promising prospects because many are established All-Stars, award winners and genuine championship contenders. Let's dive in and learn more about them. 
 Victor Wembanyama 
 Many people will agree that Wembanyama is the “once-in-a-generation talent”. San Antonio Spurs' center continues to demonstrate why the basketball world was so excited ofrh is arrival. 
 At seven feet tall, Wembanyama combines extraordinary defensive instincts with offensive skills. His size alone makes him a dangerous player, but he is also great at protecting the rim, handling the basketball and shooting from a distance. He can also create many scoring opportunities. 
 Basketball fans will agree that his influence extends beyond impressive highlights. He actually won the 2025/26 Defensive Player of the Year award and was a key reason why San Antonio reached the NBA finals. 
 Considering how things are going, it is only a matter of time before the player's stats add titles to his portfolio. He has everything needed to become one of the NBA's most dominant players. 
 Shai Gilgeous-Alexander 
 Most of the young NBA stars nowadays are already chasing their first major individual achievement. Others, like Shai Gilgeous-Alexander, however, have already reached the top of the NBA after winning the title with the Oklahoma City Thunder. The guard actually won the MVP award for best player in both 2025 and 2026, proving he is one of the best in the world. No wonder those looking for the best NBA bet of the day will often find individual markets on this player with attractive odds. 
 People who follow Shai Gilgeous-Alexander know that he is very dangerous when it comes to controlling the game. He has the ability to draw defenders out of position and this makes him vital for his team's success. 
 Considering everything he has achieved so far, there is no question whether Shai Gilgeous-Alexander can become a superstar. The question is how long he can maintain his position among the NBA's best names. 
 Anthony Edwards 
 Basketball is one of the sports where statistics are not always the most important metric. Things like personality, confidence and even performance help transform some players into global icons, and Anthony Edwards has all of these qualifications. 
 The Minnesota Timberwolves guard is famous for having explosive athleticism, aggressive scoring and a competitive personality. He has already earned the 2026 NBA All-Star Game MVP award, which highlights his ability to stand out. 
 Despite that, Edwards needs to continue improving as a player if he wishes to become one of the NBA's greatest. The competition nowadays is fierce, so he needs to prove to the rest that. 
 Luka Doncic 
 NBA fans will agree that Luka Doncic has already established himself as an elite NBA player. However, we believe that his best years could still be ahead of him. 
 One of the stars of the Los Angeles Lakers has an extraordinary understanding of offensive basketball and how to make the most of it. Instead of only relying on speed, he can manipulate defenses by navigating through his opponents and finding the best passing angles. 
 Doncic was first in the NBA scoring list in the 2025/26 season, which demonstrates his ability to carry an enormous offensive workload. It will be very important for the player to learn to lead his team to success. Becoming a team leader is never easy, but this is the next step for the NBA star. 
 Cooper Flagg - The Rising Star with Big Potential 
 Every single NBA generation has its fair share of young players who become popular before even establishing themselves. Copper Flagg is definitely one of those names. The Dallas Mavericks forward enters the league as the first overall selection in the 2025 NBA Draft and quickly justifies the excitement surrounding his potential. 
 A quick look at the stats will show you that he averaged around 21 points, 4.5 assists and 6.7 rebounds. These were enough to win him the Rookie of the Year award in 2025/26. Unlike some prospects that depend on one outstanding skill, Flagg seems to be doing well in most aspects of the game. It will be very interesting to see what will happen with him this season. 
 Other Young Stars Who Could Change the League 
 Outside of the names mentioned so far, the NBA has a few other players that fans should pay attention to. Cade Cunningham is one of them and he slowly became a central figure for the Detroit Pistons. The same applies to Paolo Banchero, a forward from the Orlando Magic who combines physical strength with offensive creativity. We can also add names like Paolo Banchero and Chet Holmgren to the list.
